headline: France blames Iran for cyberattacks on refrigeration systems
summary: France has attributed October cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration and freezer systems at more than 700 supermarkets, grocery stores and blood banks to Iranian state-backed hackers, saying the attacks caused food losses and sparked fires.

claims.statement: France linked October cyberattacks on refrigeration systems at over 700 retail locations to Iranian state-backed hackers.

sources.quote: France has linked October cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration systems at more than 700 supermarkets and other retail locations to Iranian state-backed hackers
France's foreign minister blamed Iran for launching at least two waves of cyberattacks targeting industrial refrigerated and freezer units across France and wider Europe.

claims.statement: The attacks caused food losses and sparked at least 15 fires.

sources.quote: saying the attacks caused food losses and sparked at least 15 fires.

claims.statement: TechCrunch reported the attacks also targeted freezer units at blood banks, not just grocery stores.

sources.quote: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
